boards.title: Your First Weekend at High Point University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A Friday-to-Sunday introduction to HPU through its conservatory, promenades, recreation spaces, student entertainment, gardens, library, and High Point history.

cards.title: Start among tropical plants
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Caine Conservatory
cards.notes: Arrive before the Friday closing time and walk through the exotic plant displays, listening for the conservatory’s indoor waterfalls.
cards.short_summary: Begin the weekend inside HPU’s glass-and-steel tropical plant collection.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU describes the Caine Conservatory as an immersive exotic-plant collection with waterfalls and lists its hours as Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; schedule this stop before 5:00 p.m. Friday.

cards.entity_name: Gene and Jane Kester International Promenade
cards.title: Learn the central promenade
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Kester International Promenade
cards.notes: Walk from fountain to fountain, note the international flags, and choose a historical-figure sculpture to remember as a landmark.
cards.short_summary: Use HPU’s flag-lined central walk to build a mental map of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU says Kester International Promenade has international flags, Wi-Fi, daytime classical music, 20 historical-figure sculptures, and fountains at both ends.
cards.access_notes: The source states no operating hours; remain on public campus walkways and follow university access rules.

cards.title: Try your first campus workout
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Slane Student Center
cards.notes: Bring student identification, tour the recreation facilities, and choose a low-key workout or ask staff about upcoming group classes.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the student recreation hub before the evening begins.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU Recreation Services identifies Slane Student Center as a fitness location and states that recreation services are complimentary to HPU students.
cards.access_notes: Student recreation access applies; consult the HPU REC app for facility and class availability.

cards.title: Catch a campus movie
cards.subtitle: Friday night · R.G. Wanek Center
cards.notes: Check the current screening schedule, take your HPU Passport, and arrive before the posted start time for a complimentary student showing.
cards.short_summary: Settle into a student movie screening with included theater snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU says the cinema is on the lower level of the R.G. Wanek Center and offers complimentary screenings, popcorn, candy, and soft drinks with a valid HPU Passport.
cards.access_notes: A valid HPU Passport is required; verify the current movie and showtime on the official page before going.

cards.title: End Friday with arcade games
cards.subtitle: Late Friday · R.G. Wanek Center lower level
cards.notes: Take your HPU Passport to check out equipment, then choose among consoles, pinball, billiards, or the multisport simulator.
cards.short_summary: Close the first night with a free, student-only game session.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU says students can use the Point Arcade’s games and equipment free of charge and lists Friday and Saturday standard hours as 10:00 a.m.–midnight during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Friday and Saturday: 10:00 a.m.–midnight from the first fall class through spring finals; closed during academic breaks. Bring an HPU Passport.

cards.title: Meet the city beyond campus
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · 1859 East Lexington Avenue
cards.notes: Travel off campus Saturday morning and explore the city-history exhibits before checking which historical-park buildings are accessible.
cards.short_summary: Add local history to the weekend at the city’s admission-free museum.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of High Point lists free admission, museum hours of Tuesday–Saturday from 10:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m., and Saturday access to the Historical Park.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | High Point Museum
cards.access_notes: Museum: Tuesday–Saturday, 10:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Historical Park: Saturday, 10:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; Haley House exterior only.

cards.entity_name: Mark and Julie Phillips Sculpture Garden
cards.title: Read the campus through sculpture
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Between Blessing Hall and Millis Gym
cards.notes: Follow the hillside path and compare one student-made sculpture with one professional work, using the official list to identify each piece.
cards.short_summary: Return to campus for an outdoor mix of art, plants, and student work.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU locates the garden between Blessing Hall and Millis Gym and documents permanent and rotating sculptures by North Carolina artists, students, and professors.
cards.source_title: Mark and Julie Phillips Sculpture Garden
cards.access_notes: No operating hours are stated; use the outdoor path in daylight and follow campus access rules.

cards.title: Trace the Innovation Corridor
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Mahler Family Promenade
cards.notes: Walk between Congdon, Wanek, and Wilson halls, pausing at the Topiary Fusion Garden, butterfly garden, and koi pond café tables.
cards.short_summary: Connect several academic landmarks through a garden-centered pedestrian route.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU says Mahler Family Promenade links Congdon, Wanek, and Wilson halls with the Caine Conservatory and includes gardens, Persian ironwoods, lavender, and a koi pond.
cards.access_notes: The source states no operating hours; visit the outdoor promenade in daylight and observe campus access rules.

cards.title: Locate your academic home base
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning · Beside Roberts Hall
cards.notes: Find the main floor and reference desk, then identify one study area you can return to when your first assignments arrive.
cards.short_summary: Use a quiet Sunday stop to learn where research help and core collections live.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU identifies Smith Library beside Roberts Hall as its main academic library and says its collections and services support students throughout the research process.
cards.source_title: Library Resources for Academic Success in the New Year
cards.access_notes: Confirm current weekend and academic-break hours through HPU Libraries before visiting.

cards.title: Finish beside Hayworth Park
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon · Lakeside Gardens
cards.notes: Close the weekend with a slow circuit around the garden, observing how its hollies and irises occupy a basin designed to receive runoff.
cards.short_summary: End with an outdoor reset in a named garden shaped by water and seasonal plants.
cards.evidence_claim: HPU identifies Lakeside Gardens in the center of Hayworth Park and says it features deciduous hollies and irises while functioning as a runoff basin.
cards.access_notes: No operating hours are stated; visit the outdoor garden in daylight and follow campus access rules.
